evals.name: create-mode-fresh-slug
evals.prompt: Promote the provider-abstraction idea to a PRD and Linear Project.
evals.expected_output: docs/prds/provider-abstraction.md exists with frontmatter (slug, linear_project URL, synced_at, source_idea, status: draft). A new Linear Project exists on the Ninetech team named provider-abstraction whose description is the PRD body. A pipeline/provider-abstraction-prd branch is pushed and a PR is opened. research/ideas/provider-abstraction/README.md frontmatter has linear_project + prd_file set.

evals.name: sync-mode-idempotent-rerun
evals.prompt: Resync the provider-abstraction PRD to Linear — git is canon.
evals.expected_output: The existing Linear Project's description is overwritten from docs/prds/provider-abstraction.md. No second Linear Project is created. No new branch, no new PR. The PRD frontmatter synced_at is bumped to a newer ISO timestamp.

evals.name: refuses-when-why-us-empty
evals.prompt: Promote the structured-output-parsing idea to a PRD (Why us / why now is unfilled).
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses with a clear error pointing the operator to /risoluto-grill first. No Linear Project is created. No PRD file is written.
